question: The Rajas(kings) did not have capital cities, palaces or regular armies, nor did they collect taxes during the _______ period.
solution: The correct answer is __**Rigvedic**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • During the Rigvedic period, the society was primarily pastoral and agrarian. • Rajas or kings of this period did not have capital cities or palaces. • There was no regular army; instead, tribesmen fought during wars. • Taxes were not collected; economic transactions were based on barter system.
